title: OSTBC Combiner
text: Combine inputs using orthogonal space-time block code, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point calculations; {Number of transmit antennas}, {Rate} sets the symbol rate, {Number of receive antennas}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the option to saturate on integer overflow, {Product Output} sets the complex product in numerator for diversity combining, {Accumulator} sets the summation in numerator for diversity combining, {Energy product output} sets the complex product in denominator, {Energy accumulator} sets the summation in denominator for calculating total energy in MIMO channel and {Division output} sets the normalized diversity combining by total energy in MIMO channel. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Rx
ports.summary: Received signal column vector | matrix | 3-D array

params.name: Number of receive antennas
params.values: Number of receive antennas 1 (default) | integer in range [1,8]

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Option to saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Product Output
params.values: Complex product in numerator for diversity combining Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Summation in numerator for diversity combining Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Energy product output
params.values: Complex product in denominator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Energy accumulator
params.values: Summation in denominator for calculating total energy in MIMO channel Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as accumulator | Inherit: Same as energy product output | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Division output
params.values: Normalized diversity combining by total energy in MIMO channel Inherit: Same as accumulator | fixdt(1,16,0) |
